results.name: PTR_IssueReporter.SetBugButtonContext
results.excerpt:
860: function PTR_IssueReporter.SetBugButtonContext(context, buttonTooltip, bugIcon)
861: 	context = context or PTR_IssueReporter.Data.DefaultBugButtonContext
862: 
863: 	if (PTR_IssueReporterPTR_IssueReporter ~= context) then
864: 		PTR_IssueReporter.Data.CurrentBugButtonContext = context
865: 
866: 		if (PTR_IssueReporter.ReportBug) then
867: 			PTR_IssueReporter.ReportBug:SetNormalTexture(bugIcon or PTR_IssueReporter.Assets.BugReportIcon)
868: 			PTR_IssueReporter.ReportBug:SetHighlightTexture(bugIcon or PTR_IssueReporter.Assets.BugReportIcon, "ADD")
869: 
870: 			PTR_IssueReporter.ReportBug:SetScript("OnEnter", function(self)
871: 				tooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT", 0, 0);
872: 				tooltip:SetText(PTR_IssueReporter.Data.CurrentBugButtonContext, 1, 1, 1, 1, true);
873: 				tooltip:AddLine(buttonTooltip or PTR_IssueReporter.Data.BugReportString, nil, nil, nil, true);
874: 				tooltip:SetMinimumWidth(100);
875: 				tooltip:Show()
876: 				if not(C_Glue.IsOnGlueScreen()) then
877: 					ActionButtonSpellAlertManager:HideAlert(PTR_IssueReporter.ReportBug)
878: 				end
879: 			end)
880: 
881: 			if (context ~= PTR_IssueReporter.Data.DefaultBugButtonContext) and ActionButtonSpellAlertManager then
882: 				ActionButtonSpellAlertManager:ShowAlert(PTR_IssueReporter.ReportBug) -- Highlights the fact that the button has changed purpose
883: 			end
884: 		end
885: 	end
886: end
